business_purpose: Rank eligible relationship-deepening opportunities for banker, campaign, and digital channels.
target_definition: Converted flag after campaign contact, with a synthetic holdout group to estimate incremental lift.
guardrails: Do not route products already held by the customer.
Suppress proactive outreach when consent, contactability, KYC, service issue, or cooldown checks fail.
Defer unsuitable products when income, bureau quality, age, segment, or balance criteria are not met.
Rank action candidates by actionable decision, net expected value, propensity, and priority score.
Use holdout-control rows to explain lift rather than raw conversion alone.
monitoring_pack: proxy fairness by segment, city tier, employment type, and channel preference
intended_demo_use: Banking sales demo for small banks and fintechs; not production credit, insurance, or investment advice.
